decoded.meaning: FWD{ op=REPLY, dst=/reply-ep, src=<pair 3:1>, kind=ERROR, STATUS{ ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0020 } } } - the answer a node gives a PAIR it cannot validate (RFC-0029 6 step 2, 6.3): tr::path::not_found, nothing forwarded, nothing applied, nothing repaired.
decoded.note: One answer for every way the deref fails: out of range, generation moved (the vertex was retired or its slot re-tenanted), saturated, or a placeholder. The refused element is echoed in src because the reply's src IS the request's dst. The origin's recovery is the canonical string it still holds; one failed operation is the whole cost.
